name: CrewAI
description: Role-based multi-agent orchestration framework in Python.
descriptionZh: Python 的基于角色的多 Agent 编排框架。
keyFact: CrewAI is an MIT-licensed Python framework for role-based multi-agent orchestration; its GitHub repository had roughly 57,000 stars as of August 2026.
keyFactZh: CrewAI 是 MIT 许可的 Python 多 Agent 编排框架，采用基于角色的协作模型；截至 2026 年 8 月其 GitHub 仓库约有 57,000 星标。
